output: html_document

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
```


read shapes
```{r}
in_75_shp <- "../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/processed/01_shapefiles/jis_zones/jis_zones_75km_envelope.shp"



shp_jis <- st_read(in_75_shp) %>% rename(zone = id)

shp_gunma <- st_read("../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/raw/01_shapefiles/gunma_2450/gunma_2450.shp") 


```

# 1500 vehicles

```{r}
in_wait_times_1500 <- "../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/processed/drt/wait_times-1500-gunma.csv"
out_wait_shp_1500 <- "../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/processed/drt/wait_times-1500-gunma.shp"
```



```{r}

zone_stats_raw_1500 <- read_csv(in_wait_times_1500)

zone_stats <- zone_stats_raw_1500 %>% 
  group_by(zone) %>% 
  summarise(mean_wait = as.integer(mean(waiting_time)), median_wait = as.integer(median(waiting_time)), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(zone = as.character(zone))

zone_stats_raw_1500 %>% ggplot() + geom_histogram(aes(waiting_time))

study_area_stats <- zone_stats_raw_1500 %>% summarise(mean_wait = as.integer(mean(waiting_time)), median_wait = as.integer(median(waiting_time)), n = n(), max_wait = as.integer(max(waiting_time)))

study_area_stats

merged_1500 <- left_join(shp_jis,zone_stats, by ="zone") %>% filter(str_starts(zone,"10"))

merged_1500 %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%  summarise(max_median = max(median_wait), max_mean = max(mean_wait))



merged_1500 %>% select(typ_wt = mean_wait) %>%
st_write(out_wait_shp_1500)


```


plots for paper
```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")
fig_map_wait_1500 <- merged_1500  %>% 
  mutate(median_wait = median_wait / 60, mean_wait = mean_wait / 60) %>% 
  tm_shape() + tm_polygons(fill = "mean_wait", breaks = c(0,5,10,15,20,25,Inf),    title = "Mean Wait\nTime (min)") + tm_basemap("Stadia.StamenTerrainBackground", api = "996f61fe-f7b6-4641-bb2b-555eca9cdd21") +
  tm_layout(  legend.outside = FALSE,
  legend.position = c("right", "top"), scale = 2)

fig_map_wait_1500

tmap_save(fig_map_wait_1500, filename = "/Users/jakob/Dropbox/Documents/04_Work-VSP/007_papers/2026-03b-hEART/figures/results_wait_map_1500.png")




```

# COMPARISON
```{r}

fig_boxplot_wait_compare <- zone_stats_raw_1500 %>% 
  mutate(vehicles = "1500", zone = as.character(zone)) %>% 
  bind_rows(zone_stats_raw_2500 %>% mutate(vehicles = "2500")) %>% 
  mutate(waiting_time = waiting_time/60) %>% 
  ggplot() + geom_boxplot(aes(vehicles, waiting_time),outlier.shape = NA) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  ylim(0,20) +
  labs(x = "Fleet Size", y = "Wait Time (min)")

fig_boxplot_wait_compare

ggsave(fig_boxplot_wait_compare, filename = "/Users/jakob/Dropbox/Documents/04_Work-VSP/007_papers/2026-03b-hEART/figures/results_wait_boxplot_compare.png")
```
